title: SvgFeFuncA
responsibility: Renders the native feFuncA element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgFeFuncA.children
inputs.description: An optional Svelte snippet rendered inside the native feFuncA element when present; when omitted, no child snippet is rendered. It is used only as element content.

outputs.name: SvgFeFuncA
outputs.description: The native SVG feFuncA markup produced by this component, with supplied attributes spread onto it and the optional snippet rendered as its content; no wrapper element is added.
